title: MarchewkaSMP
body:
![MarchewkaSMP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46e686ee354a15c33c2b165091142e7f3403bdb3_0.webp) ![Text Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bd9fa9ac8d071e32e80a61bcc2fc165af07c7e1.png)

A lightweight Vanilla+ Medieval RPG experience built for SMP gameplay, roleplay, kingdoms, trade, and long-term worldbuilding.

![Custom Separator](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1302359760376430642/1520431901507195021/carrot_separator.png?ex=6a412c0d&is=6a3fda8d&hm=4f4bb3ea726e7756bfafca765c08a7a00215bc8d3d3d110e7a77102fe15bcca5&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1872&height=62) # 🏰 MarchewkaSMP Modpack MarchewkaSMP Modpack expands Minecraft without losing its vanilla identity. Instead of forced progression or overcomplicated mechanics, it focuses on **immersion, creativity, multiplayer interaction, and medieval atmosphere**. Perfect for players who want to create **settlements, kingdoms, economies, conflicts, taverns, trade routes, and stories shaped entirely by the community.** --- ## ⚔️ Enhanced Medieval Combat Combat stays recognizable, but becomes far more immersive. - ✔️ Improved combat animations & weapon handling - ✔️ Medieval weapons, shields, armor & equipment - ✔️ More satisfying PvP and PvE encounters - ✔️ Vanilla-friendly combat improvements without turning Minecraft into a grindy RPG **Includes:** *[Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat), [Epic Knights](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-knights-shields-armor-and-weapons), [YDM's Weapon Master](https://modrinth.com/mod/weaponmaster)* --- ## 🏰 Massive Building & Decoration Expansion Build worlds that actually feel medieval. Create castles, villages, taverns, kingdom capitals, markets, roads, farms, fortresses, harbor towns. The pack includes a huge collection of decorative and structural content: - ✔️ Roofs, bridges, windows, paths, doors, fences & furniture - ✔️ Medieval-themed decorations and utility blocks - ✔️ Improved environmental detail and world aesthetics **Includes:** *[Macaw's](https://modrinth.com/user/sketchmacaw), [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries), [Dusty Decorations](https://modrinth.com/mod/dusty-decorations) and more* --- ## 🍞 Food, Farming & Cozy Survival Survival becomes richer without becoming complicated. Expand everyday gameplay with cooking, baking, brewing, winemaking, herbal drinks, camping, pottery and farming improvements. Create functioning: - 🍺 Taverns - 🍞 Bakeries - 🍷 Vineyards - 🌾 Farms - 🏕️ Campsites **Includes:** *[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) and [Let’s Do Series](https://modrinth.com/user/u5d114le)* --- ## 🪙 Economy, Roleplay & Multiplayer Features Built primarily for **community-driven SMP gameplay**. Support for: - ✔️ Player economies - ✔️ Shops & merchants - ✔️ NPC interaction - ✔️ Kingdoms & factions - ✔️ Diplomacy & conflicts - ✔️ Community storytelling Communicate naturally with integrated voice chat and multiplayer-focused systems. **Includes:** *[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat), [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/mod/rpgcoins), [Spud's Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/spuds-shops)* --- ## 🌍 Exploration & World Improvements The world feels larger, more alive, and more adventurous. Features include: - ✔️ Improved world generation - ✔️ Overhauled villages - ✔️ Roads & travel systems - ✔️ Seasonal changes - ✔️ Ships & transport - ✔️ Better exploration tools and mapping Explore a Minecraft world that remains **strongly Vanilla+**, while offering much greater variety and atmosphere. **Includes:** *[William Wythers’ Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo), [ChoiceTheorem Villages](https://modrinth.com/mod/ct-overhaul-village), [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons), [Antique Atlas](https://modrinth.com/mod/antique-atlas-4), [Via Romana](https://modrinth.com/mod/via-romana) and more* --- ## ✨ Immersion & Visual Enhancements Minecraft should *feel alive.* The pack adds: - 🌧️ Ambient environmental sounds - 🔥 Dynamic lighting - 🎭 Better animations - 🌙 Enhanced visuals - 🌲 Richer environments - 🎨 Optional shaders & visual customization Multiple shaderpacks and visual improvements are included for players who want maximum atmosphere. **Includes:** *[AmbientSounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds), [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered), [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations), [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) and more* --- ## ⚡ Lightweight & Optimized Despite its large feature set, the pack is designed to remain **smooth, stable, and lightweight**. Performance improvements include: - ✔️ FPS optimization - ✔️ Reduced memory usage - ✔️ Faster loading - ✔️ SMP-friendly performance tuning Runs well on most systems while still delivering a significantly richer experience than vanilla. **Powered by:** *[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast), [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling), [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) and more* --- ## 🎯 Designed For This modpack is ideal for players who enjoy: - Vanilla+ gameplay - Medieval aesthetics - SMP servers - Roleplay communities - Kingdom building - Economy systems - Creative building - Long-term worlds - Immersive multiplayer experiences > **Build kingdoms. Open taverns. Create trade empires. Start wars. Tell stories.** **Marchewka SMP Modpack** is built to let players create their own medieval world - not follow a scripted one. ![Custom Separator](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1302359760376430642/1520431901507195021/carrot_separator.png?ex=6a412c0d&is=6a3fda8d&hm=4f4bb3ea726e7756bfafca765c08a7a00215bc8d3d3d110e7a77102fe15bcca5&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1872&height=62) ## DISCLAIMER Pack contains [Hide Player Nametags](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hide-player-nametags) mod by shadowgoverment from Curseforge, added under MIT License. ## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Is this modpack server-friendly? Yes. MarchewkaSMP Modpack was designed primarily for **multiplayer and long-term SMP gameplay**. It includes multiplayer-focused features such as economy systems, voice chat, NPCs, improved villages, optimization mods, and tools that support community-driven gameplay.
Can I play this in Singleplayer? Absolutely. While the pack was built with **SMP and roleplay communities** in mind, it works perfectly in singleplayer if you enjoy **medieval building, exploration, immersive survival, or Vanilla+ gameplay**.
Does this modpack heavily change vanilla Minecraft? No. The goal of MarchewkaSMP is to remain firmly **Vanilla+**. You will find improved combat, new building options, expanded food systems, better immersion, and richer world generation — but without forced progression, complex tech trees, or overwhelming RPG mechanics.
Does the modpack support shaders? Yes. The pack includes **Iris Shaders** and multiple pre-installed shaderpacks, allowing you to customize visuals depending on your hardware and preferred style. You can also play completely without shaders.
Is the modpack optimized? Yes. Performance and stability were a major priority during development. The pack includes numerous optimization mods such as: * Sodium * Lithium * FerriteCore * ImmediatelyFast * Entity Culling * Dynamic FPS It is designed to stay relatively lightweight while still providing a much richer experience than vanilla Minecraft.
What kind of gameplay is this pack built for? The pack is designed around: * Medieval building * Kingdoms & settlements * Roleplay * Economy & trade * Community storytelling * Exploration * Long-term SMP worlds * Immersive Vanilla+ survival
Do I need a powerful PC? Not necessarily. The pack aims to remain **lightweight and optimized**, but performance will still depend on your hardware, render distance, shaders, and selected settings. Lower-end systems can disable shaders and adjust graphics options for smoother gameplay.
